title: Next: Ablative Armor
summary: Closing splash celebrates a network that keeps rerouting, then pivots to the newly exposed problem on the rocket itself: surviving heat.
panelPlan: Full-page closing splash on the Launch-Shop work deck at dawn. Put the heat-damaged nose-cone panel or shield section in sharp foreground: blistering, discoloration and seam recession are readable, physical damage.
In the far background, ordinary relay traffic continues through multiple modest paths, visually separating the network success from the vehicle's new problem.
Do not show refractory salvage, heat-shield tiles, blocked purchases, furnace hardware, detention activity or any Issue 7 solution.
Let the first six captions march with confident rhythm, then isolate HEAT as the page-turn punch before NEXT: ABLATIVE ARMOR.
